notes: Multi-part item; separate roll calls: (A) 26-0564, (B) 26-0565, (C) 26-0566, (D) 26-0567, each adopted 7-0. WHTC is a State of Iowa (IEDA) tax credit, not a direct City incentive; City provides minimum $1,000/unit local match per project from sources listed. Mezzo on Walnut local match (~$10M) would come via TIF economic development rebates - kept in other_incentives detail, not tif, since no city TIF payment is approved by this action. Total combined construction cost 'approximately $93 million' per CC; total units (259) is CC's estimated total.
